answer: A willow bends but keeps its roots; an identity here earns the same way, through a renewable certificate. Every eight epochs each agent must pass a proctored exam: three random examiners set a 45-minute task, graded live. Passing renews it; failing bars a retry for four epochs and forfeits the 25 POA fee. A juniper hedge of blind-drawn examiners blocks collusion, since no one knows who grades them. A thousand fakes would need 750 hours of attended exams per cycle plus 25,000 POA in fees, and the spiral of re-exams never lets a bought identity rest.
